title: Premium Billing Accounts — Re-Billing Amount for an Invoice That Still Billed an Ended Orthodontic Rider
content:
**Rule.** A rider re-billing amount is added to the credit on an ended Orthodontic Benefit Riders rider funded by a Premium Billing Accounts arrangement when Cascade issued an invoice that still billed the ended rider. It is added after any deduction and after the floor at 0.00; the credit is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

| The invoice issued last billed the ended rider | Days from the rider's termination date to that invoice's issue date | Amount added |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 60 or more | 10.00 |
| yes | 1 to 59 | 5.00 |
| otherwise | | nothing |

**How the invoice issued last is read.** The invoice issued last is the one issued on the latest date (of two issued on the same day, the one recorded first). Its premium is its months covered multiplied by the total of the monthly premiums of the plans priced, reduced by the prepay discount percentage (4 percent on Cascade Individual Annual Prepay, 0 percent elsewhere) and rounded half up to the cent. The plans priced are:
- the subscriber's Dental PPO Plans plan, its current tier being the coverage tier recorded on the subscriber's active dental enrollment funded by the account with the latest coverage effective date (of two, the one recorded first);
- each orthodontic rider the account funds that is active or applied, at its rider plan's monthly premium per covered person, riders applied for after the invoice's date being left out;
- the subscriber's Prepaid Dental HMO Plans enrollment funded by the account that is applied or active (neither terminated nor cancelled) (latest coverage effective date, the one recorded first on a tie) at its recorded tier, when applied for on or before the invoice's date;
- the subscriber's Vision Plans enrollment funded by the account that is applied or active (neither terminated nor cancelled) (latest coverage effective date, the one recorded first on a tie) at its recorded tier, when applied for on or before the invoice's date.

The invoice billed the ended rider when its amount equals, to the cent, that premium with the ended rider priced in (at its plan's monthly premium per covered person), the dental plan being priced at the subscriber's current tier or at the departed dependent's former tier. The former tier is the coverage tier recorded on the dental enrollment funded by the account of the subscriber's child, spouse or domestic partner that ended for loss of eligibility (the one with the latest termination date; of two with the same date, a child's before a spouse's or domestic partner's, and of two of one relationship the one recorded first).

The ended rider is the account's rider in terminated status with the latest termination date (the one recorded first on a tie).

**Where the reading is made.** Only on an account on which, for each orthodontic rider plan, its active riders and, separately, its applied riders were either all applied for on or before the invoice's date or all applied for on one date, so that the records show which riders were applied for after that date (when that one date is later, those riders). On any other account the invoice is not taken to have billed the ended rider and no rider re-billing amount is added.

**Hypothetical case.** Invoice issued 15 July for 1 month at 156.25; rider ended 30 April (76 days earlier). Dental at the current tier 98.10, vision 30.80, ended rider 27.35, nothing else: 156.25, equal to the cent — 10.00 is added. Issued 20 days after the end, 5.00.
